description: Query Erhao HR data across HR records, organization, attendance and payroll with natural language: employee roster/transfers/contracts, org structure and distribution, attendance/leave/overtime, and payroll/cost/tax analysis.

display.description_en: Query Erhao HR data across HR records, organization, attendance and payroll with natural language: employee roster/transfers/contracts, org structure and distribution, attendance/leave/overtime, and payroll/cost/tax analysis.
display.description_zh: 通过自然语言查询人事、组织、考勤与薪酬四域数据：员工花名册/异动/合同、组织架构与维度分布、考勤/假期/加班、薪资核算/成本/个税，为人力分析提供数据支撑。
examples_en: How many people are in each department, by level?
List employees who left this month and count leavers per department
What was last month's overall attendance rate, and which department had the most lateness?
Show this month's leave records grouped by leave type in days
What were last month's total net pay and average cost per employee by department?
Show me the job positions and job titles of the R&D department, with headcount per position
Total overtime hours by department this quarter, split by weekday, weekend and holiday
Check contract status — who has not signed a contract yet?
Query last quarter's tax records grouped by tax unit
How many people joined and how many completed probation in each department in the last six months?
examples_zh: 查一下公司各部门有多少人，按职级分布
列出本月离职的员工，并统计各部门离职人数
上月整体出勤率是多少，迟到早退最多的部门是哪个
查一下本月的请假明细，按假期类型汇总天数
上月各部门的实发工资总额和人均成本是多少
帮我看下研发部的岗位和职务设置，以及各岗位的在职人数
统计本季度各部门的加班时长，按工作日、休息日、节假日区分
查一下员工的合同签订情况，有哪些人还没签合同
查询上个季度的个税明细，按纳税单位分组
近六个月各部门的入职和转正人数分别是多少
